tool_schemas.name: get_config
tool_schemas.description: Returns the server’s configuration metadata used to connect and authenticate with Dart, and does not create or modify any workspace data. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any unexpected parameters are provided, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read configuration for this deployment. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks visible to the caller, optionally filtered by workspace, dartboard, parent task, assignee, lifecycle fields (status/priority/size), tags, text query, and date ranges, and returns a page of results ordered by the requested sort field and direction. Results are paginated with limit (1–200) and cursor; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, timestamps, enums, or contradictory ranges (e.g., due_after later than due_before), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the requested workspace or dartboard, NOT_FOUND when a specified workspace/dartboard/parent task does not exist or is not visible, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to list tasks from.

parent_task_id.description: Filter tasks by parent task ID (subtasks of this task).

assignee_id.description: Filter tasks assigned to a specific user.

tag_name.description: Filter tasks that include a given tag name.

query.description: Search query to match against task title and/or description.

due_before.description: Only include tasks with due_at before this timestamp.

due_after.description: Only include tasks with due_at after this timestamp.

start_before.description: Only include tasks with start_at before this timestamp.

start_after.description: Only include tasks with start_at after this timestamp.

completed_before.description: Only include tasks with completed_at before this timestamp.

completed_after.description: Only include tasks with completed_at after this timestamp.

is_trashed.description: Whether to include trashed tasks (true) or only non-trashed tasks (false).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task in the specified workspace with the provided title and optional fields (description, status, priority, size, start/due dates, dartboard, parent task, assignees, and tags) and returns the created task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, any IDs or enums are invalid, or date fields are malformed, and raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace, dartboard, parent task, or assignees do not exist or are not visible to the caller. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to create tasks in the workspace or assign users, and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to create the task in.

dartboard_id.description: Dartboard ID to place the task into.

parent_task_id.description: Optional parent task ID to create this task as a subtask.

assignee_ids.description: List of user IDs assigned to the task.

tag_names.description: List of tag names to apply to the task.

tool_schemas.name: get_task
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single task by ID and returns its full task record, including status, priority, size, dates, assignees, tags, and trash state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if task_id is not well-formed, NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the task’s workspace. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing task’s mutable fields (such as title, description, status, priority, size, dates, dartboard/parent, assignees, and tags) and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid field values (including malformed timestamps and invalid enums/IDs), NOT_FOUND if the task or any newly referenced dartboard/parent/assignee does not exist or is not visible, and CONFLICT if the requested parent_task_id would create an invalid hierarchy (e.g., setting the task as its own ancestor). Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot edit the task or move it to the specified dartboard, and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

dartboard_id.description: Move task to a different dartboard ID.

parent_task_id.description: Set or change the parent task ID.

completed_at.description: Set the completion timestamp (or update it).

assignee_ids.description: Replace the list of assignee user IDs.

tag_names.description: Replace the list of tag names.

tool_schemas.name: delete_task
tool_schemas.description: Moves the specified task to the trash (soft-delete) and returns the task in its trashed state without otherwise altering its fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if task_id is not well-formed, NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist or is not visible, and CONFLICT if the task is already trashed. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to trash the task, and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

task_id.description: Task ID to move to trash.

tool_schemas.name: list_docs
tool_schemas.description: Lists docs visible to the caller, optionally filtered by workspace, folder, status, title, text query, and trash state, and returns a page of matching docs. Results are paginated with limit (1–200) and cursor; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available, and ordering follows the requested sort field and direction. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums or malformed paging inputs, NOT_FOUND when a specified workspace or folder does not exist or is not visible, FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the workspace/folder, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to list docs from.

title.description: Filter docs by title (exact or partial match).

query.description: Search query to match against doc title and/or text content.

is_trashed.description: Whether to include trashed docs (true) or only non-trashed docs (false).

limit.description: Maximum number of docs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create_doc
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new doc in the specified workspace with the provided title and content (rich text and/or plaintext) and optional folder and status, and returns the created doc. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, content fields are invalid, or status is not one of the allowed values, and NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace or folder does not exist or is not visible to the caller. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to create docs in the workspace or write into the folder, and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to create the doc in.

folder_id.description: Folder ID to place the doc into.

tool_schemas.name: get_doc
tool_schemas.description: Retrieve an existing doc by its ID. Returns the doc's information including title, text content, folder, and more.

doc_id.description: The ID of the doc to retrieve (e.g., dart_doc_01H8XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).

tool_schemas.name: update_doc
tool_schemas.description: Update an existing doc. You can modify its title, text content, and folder.

doc_id.description: The ID of the doc to update (e.g., dart_doc_01H8XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).

content_text.description: New rich-text/markdown content for the doc.

folder_id.description: New folder ID to move the doc into.

tool_schemas.name: delete_doc
tool_schemas.description: Moves the specified doc to the trash (soft delete) and returns the updated doc record; the doc remains recoverable and is not otherwise modified. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if doc_id is missing or does not match the required format, and NOT_FOUND if no doc exists with that ID or it is not accessible to you. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to trash the doc in its dartboard/folder, and CONFLICT if the doc is already trashed or cannot be trashed due to its current lifecycle state.

doc_id.description: The ID of the doc to move to trash (e.g., dart_doc_01H8XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).
